title: Macron says 'unrealistic' to open Hormuz Strait by force, urges Trump to 'be serious'
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron on Thursday said it would be unrealistic to launch a military operation to force open the Strait of Hormuz after US President Donald Trump challenged allies to work towards reopening it.
